column2: Python is a programming language used to build software and applications.
Artificial Intelligence enables computers to perform tasks that usually require human intelligence.
Machine Learning helps computers learn patterns from data.
A variable is a name used to store a value in a program.
A loop repeats a block of code multiple times.
A function is a reusable block of code that performs a specific task.
A dataset is a collection of related data used for analysis or machine learning.
Natural Language Processing helps computers process and understand human language.
Python is used for automation data analysis web development and AI projects.
An algorithm is a sequence of steps used to solve a problem.
